svg.title: Example with made-up inputs: annual cost of daily lenses versus monthly lenses
svg.desc: Example with made-up inputs, not real prices; the reader should plug in their own quotes. Two bars from a labelled worksheet row, not a shelf price. Dailies are $1,120 and monthlies are $273 under the assumptions printed on the chart.
svg.text: Example with made-up box prices (both eyes, 365 days). Plug in your own quotes.
Dailies: 25 boxes x $40, plus a $120 exam. Solution and case are $0 on this row.
Monthlies: 1 box x $45, solution $96, case $12, exam $120. Two-week lenses are $328 in the table only.
Bar length: $1,120 = 440 px. Replace every dollar with your quote before you decide.
Saving Optimizer, 27 Sep 2026. Arithmetic only. No box price was opened.
